headline: Russian Diesel Exports Doubled as the World Scrambled for Fuel
facebook_description: Russian diesel exports doubled in October to approximately 270,000 barrels per day. The recovery followed a Washington–Moscow agreement aimed at increasing global fuel supplies. Renewed Ukrainian refinery attacks threaten that recovery. Higher exports do not necessarily mean higher profits: repair costs, discounts and lost production matter. Can Moscow sustain the recovery? #EPNews #Russia #Diesel #Geopolitics
